title: Pure Tearlaments
summary: Pure Tearlaments mill and Fusion strategy focused on churning through the Deck to trigger graveyard Fusion Summons by shuffling materials back into the Deck. With Kitkallos Forbidden and the main-deck sirens Limited, the deck uses King of the Swamp as a fusion substitute and relies on Reinoheart and Tearlaments Kashtira to maintain relentless fusion loops.

summary.title: Starters
points: Tearlaments Reinoheart sends a Tearlaments monster from your Deck to the GY on Normal or Special Summon, and Special Summons itself from the GY when sent there by card effect by discarding a Tearlaments card.
Tearlaments Kashtira Special Summons itself during either player's Main Phase by banishing a Kashtira or Tearlaments card, and mills 3 cards from the top of either player's Deck when sent to the GY.

Primeval Planet Perlereino searches any Tearlaments monster from your Deck on activation, gives your monsters 500 ATK, and destroys 1 card on the field whenever a Tearlaments monster is shuffled into the Deck.
King of the Swamp discards itself to add Polymerization, and substitutes for named fusion materials like the banned Kitkallos to enable Tearlaments Rulkallos.
Tearlaments Merrli, Havnis, and Scheiren each mill 3 cards and perform a Fusion Summon by shuffling materials from hand, field, or GY into the bottom of the Deck when sent to the GY by card effect.

summary.title: Opening: Primeval Planet Perlereino
steps: Activate Primeval Planet Perlereino to search Tearlaments Reinoheart from your Deck.
Normal Summon Tearlaments Reinoheart and activate its effect to send Tearlaments Scheiren from Deck to GY.
Trigger Scheiren's GY effect to perform a Fusion Summon by shuffling Scheiren and King of the Swamp into the Deck to summon Tearlaments Rulkallos.
Perlereino triggers upon shuffling a monster back to target and destroy 1 card your opponent controls.
Set Tearlaments Sulliek or Tearlaments Metanoise to mill additional monsters and negate opponent plays on their turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Tearlaments Rulkallos protects your other Aqua monsters from battle destruction, negates an effect that includes an effect that Special Summons a monster and destroys it as a Quick Effect, and Special Summons itself from the GY if sent there by card effect.

Tearlaments Kaleido-Heart shuffles 1 card on the field into the Deck on Fusion Summon or when an Aqua is sent to your GY by card effect, cannot be used as Fusion Material, and revives itself while sending a Tearlaments card from Deck to GY.
Garura, Wings of Resonant Life is easily summoned using 2 DARK Aqua Tearlaments, inflicts double battle damage, and draws 1 card when sent to the GY.
Mudragon of the Swamp declares an Attribute to protect monsters of that Attribute from opponent targeting, summoned using Reinoheart and Tearlaments Kashtira.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Tearlaments Sulliek negates the effects of an opponent's face-up effect monster by sending a monster you control to the GY, and searches any Tearlaments monster when sent to the GY by card effect.
Tearlaments Cryme Counter Trap negates the activation of a Spell, Trap, or monster effect and shuffles that card into the Deck by sending a monster from your hand to the GY.
Tearlaments Scream mills 3 cards whenever a monster is Normal or Special Summoned, and searches a Tearlaments Trap when sent to the GY by card effect.
Tearlaments Grief Special Summons a Tearlaments monster from your Deck or GY, then sends a monster you control with the same Type to the GY.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Tearlaments Kitkallos is Forbidden in the TCG, and external engines such as Ishizu millers, Shaddolls, and Fiendsmith are omitted to focus on pure archetype interaction.

main: Tearlaments Reinoheart
Summoned: mills a Tearlaments monster; milled itself, comes back and sends a Tearlaments card from the hand.
Tearlaments Kashtira
Summons itself on either Main Phase and mills three cards from either Deck.
Tearlaments Merrli
Limited. Summoned: mills three; milled, Fusion Summons by shuffling materials back.
Tearlaments Havnis
Limited. Joins when their monster activates and mills three; milled, Fusion Summons.
Tearlaments Scheiren
Limited. Summons itself, discards, and mills three; milled, Fusion Summons.
King of the Swamp
Generic Aqua that substitutes for Kitkallos to make Rulkallos (the page's substitution line).
Primeval Planet Perlereino
Field Spell: searches a Tearlaments monster, and destroys a card when one shuffles back.
Tearlaments Perlegia
Second Field Spell: mills a Level 4 or lower Aqua when a Tearlaments Aqua is milled.
Tearlaments Grief
Summons a Tearlaments from the Deck or GY, then sends one of yours to the GY.
Tearlaments Scream
Mills three when a monster is summoned; milled, searches a Tearlaments Trap.
Tearlaments Heartbeat
Quick-Play: shuffles a Spell/Trap away and discards; milled, returns a Tearlaments Trap.
Tearlaments Sulliek
Negates a monster and sends one of yours; milled, searches a Tearlaments monster.
Tearlaments Cryme
Counter Trap: negates and shuffles away the card, then sends a monster from your hand.

Flips a monster face-down and mills a Tearlaments monster.

Reinoheart + two Aqua: shuffles a card away whenever an Aqua is milled.
Generic Fusion: two DARK Aqua Tearlaments make it, and it draws when sent to the GY.
Generic Fusion for two WATER monsters of different Types, such as Reinoheart and Tearlaments Kashtira.
